name: Testing Acids and Bases with Indicators
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; Class 10 acids, bases and salts activity page to verify
educational_goal: Classify household solutions as acidic, basic, or neutral using safe indicator color changes.

steps.description: Label small wells or test tubes for each sample and add equal volumes.
steps.observation: The samples are arranged for side-by-side comparison.
steps.key_visual: The samples are arranged for side-by-side comparison.

scenes.description: A white tile holds labeled drops of household solutions beside red and blue litmus strips and a universal indicator dropper.

steps.description: Touch blue and red litmus paper to each sample using clean droppers.
steps.observation: Acidic and basic samples produce opposite litmus changes.
steps.key_visual: Acidic and basic samples produce opposite litmus changes.

steps.description: Add universal indicator to fresh portions of the samples.
steps.observation: Different colors indicate different approximate pH values.
steps.key_visual: Different colors indicate different approximate pH values.
